Proof in the paper: The diffraction pattern of the latter catalyst shows the main characteristic peaks of the face centered cubic, fcc, Pt crystalline structure ([03-065-2868] ICDD-PDF) with the lattice parameter of 0.3928 nm and the average particle size of ∼2 nm. High resolution transmission electron micrographs, HRTEM, (Fig. 4B) clearly indicated that these particles are of fcc type whose orientation is close to {110} i.e. Fast Fourier transforms (FFTs) show planes of {111} and {200} types.
